request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Math Club is putting together the Pi Day Puzzle Hunt, an event where teams of students solve puzzles across campus. It is meant for students who enjoy a good challenge and a bit of friendly teamwork, whether or not they think of themselves as math people. We are reaching out to you as a fellow recognized student organization because we would love to co-host the event with our club. Your involvement would help make the hunt feel welcoming to a wider mix of students, and it would mean more of the people who come get to share a fun, collaborative afternoon exploring campus together.","contains_instructions":false}
